_doc: Ocean currents (world/oceanCurrents.js). Every sea hex has one, set by the latitude bands (|latitude| 0 at the equator to 1 at the poles; angle in degrees: 0 runs east, 180 west, 90 north) and wandering up to `wander` degrees either way over stretches of `scale` hexes (smooth noise of the world's seed); strength from minStrength to 1, dying away within edgeFade of a band's edge where two streams meet; coastal water runs at `coast` of it. sail: a ship on the world map (player/core/movement.js) pays a hex's sailing cost less by with x strength going with the current, more by against x strength going into it; lying at sea overnight (not in a port) it is carried driftPerDay x strength of a hex downstream each night, a whole hex when that adds up to one (ui/game/endDay.js). swim: cells a second a swimmer on the street map is carried (world/innerMap/currents.js) in the sea (sea x strength) and mid-river (river; bankShare of that next to the bank or over a ford; lakes and ponds lie still); the Swimming skill holds against it, up to skillResist of it at the top.

display._doc: The world map's current streaks (ui/renderer/currents.js): drawn on charted sea hexes from minZoom up, `streaks` a hex at full strength, `length` in hex radii, drifting `speed` of a hex a second, colour as r,g,b at `alpha`; `modes` multiplies the alpha in a map mode (and draws arrowheads there when arrowsInModes).
